 Match Predictions: Abu Dhabi T10 2026 - United Tigers vs Emirates Eagles - Royal Desert Champions vs Yas Lions - Arabian Aces vs UAE Bulls
 Match Predictions: Abu Dhabi T10 2026 ©CWM 
 By Cricket World Staff 
 Thursday 12 November 2026 
 Abu Dhabi T10 League 
 T10 series Schedule 13th Match, Abu Dhabi Fri 13 Nov United Tigers 141/5 10 ov Emirates Eagles 119/2 10 ov United Tigers won by 22 runs
 Scorecard Stats 
 14th Match, Abu Dhabi Fri 13 Nov Royal Desert Champions 136/4 10 ov Yas Lions 97/6 10 ov Royal Desert Champions won by 39 runs
 Scorecard Stats 
 15th Match, Abu Dhabi Fri 13 Nov Arabian Aces 92/8 10 ov UAE Bulls 84/7 10 ov Arabian Aces won by 8 runs
 Scorecard Stats 
 Here are the Predictions for Abu Dhabi T10 2026, 13th Match - United Tigers vs Emirates Eagles; 14th Match - Royal Desert Champions vs Yas Lions and 15th Match - Arabian Aces vs UAE Bulls, to be played on the 13th of November at the Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi.
 Match Prediction - United Tigers v Emirates Eagles 
 13th Match - United Tigers vs Emirates Eagles (Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average 1st Innings Total at Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi (Abu Dhabi T10) - 116 
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi (Abu Dhabi T10) - 105 
 Current Form United Tigers:
 United Tigers are currently placed at the 1st position on points table with 3 wins and 1 loss to their credit. They have 6 points to their name. 
 The top run scorer for United Tigers in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Fakhar Zaman with 129 runs to his name. 
 The top wicket taker for United Tigers in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Abbas Afridi with 6 scalps under his belt. 
 United Tigers have lost their previous match against Yas Lions by 13 runs.
 Yas Lions batted first and they posted a total of 115 for 5 in 10 overs. James Vince , Andries Gous and Dasun Shanaka got out cheaply. After their dismissals, Tom Moores and Karim Janat carted the bowlers to all parts of the ground. Moores made 33 off 18 balls while Janat scored 33 off only 11 deliveries to help Yas Lions get to 115 in their innings.
 During the chase, Sahibzada Farhan and Fakhar Zaman got their team off to a decent start. Fakhar Zaman in particular was simply destructive with the bat. After Farhan got out, the middle order collapsed. Fakhar Zaman made 44 off 23 balls but he barely got any support from the other batters. Wickets kept falling in regular succession. United Tigers failed to generate enough momentum and they were eventually restricted to 102 for 5 in 10 overs, losing the match by 13 runs.
 Current Form Emirates Eagles:
 Emirates Eagles are currently placed at the 3rd position on points table with 2 wins and 2 losses to their credit. They have 4 points to their name. 
 The top run scorer for Emirates Eagles in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Shimron Hetmyer with 160 runs to his name. 
 The top wicket taker for Emirates Eagles in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Haider Razzaq with 8 scalps under his belt. 
 Emirates Eagles have won their previous match against UAE Bulls by 25 runs.
 Emirates Eagles batted first and they posted a total of 137 for 7 in 10 overs. Kyle Mayers and Kusal Perera got out without troubling the scorers much. After their dismissals, Shimron Hetmyer and Rovman Powell took the responsibility of taking Eagles to a respectable total. Hetmyer hit 7 fours and 6 sixes for his knock of 76 while Powell scored 43 runs in only 20 balls to power Emirates Eagles to a tall total of 137 in 10 overs of play.
 During the chase, UAE Bulls started badly, losing both Andre Fletcher and Aneurin Donald within the Powerplay overs. Khawaja Nafay also failed to impress and scored only 11 runs. Kieron Pollard fought hard and scored 33 runs off 17 balls but he also got out at a wrong time. UAE Bulls faltered in the death overs and fell short by 25 runs in the end.

 Match Prediction - Royal Desert Champions v Yas Lions 
 14th Match - Royal Desert Champions vs Yas Lions (Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average 1st Innings Total at Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi (Abu Dhabi T10) - 116 
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi (Abu Dhabi T10) - 105 
 Current Form Royal Desert Champions:
 Royal Desert Champions are currently placed at the bottom most position on points table with 1 win and 3 losses to their credit. They have 2 points to their name. 
 The top run scorer for Royal Desert Champions in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Phil Salt with 83 runs to his name. 
 The top wicket taker for Royal Desert Champions in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Keemo Paul with 2 scalps under his belt. 
 Royal Desert Champions have won their previous match against UAE Bulls by 6 wickets.
 UAE Bulls batted first and they posted a total of 123 for 7 in 10 overs. Aneurin Donald and Andre Fletcher got the starts but failed to convert them into bigger scores. It was Khawaja Nafay and Kieron Pollard , who infused momentum into the innings with knocks of 27 and 23 runs respectively. The rest of the batters failed to leave any impact and UAE Bulls had to settle for a total of 123, even though at one point, they were aiming at 135+.
 During the chase, Royal Desert Champions couldn't get off to an ideal start and they were reduced to 34 for 3 in the 4th over. After that phase, Muhammad Waseem and Sherfane Rutherford took the responsibility of taking Royal Desert Champions over the line. Waseem made 36 off 18 while Rutherford scored 40 runs in 13 deliveries as Royal Desert Champions managed to get over the line in the 10th over with 6 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Yas Lions:
 Yas Lions are currently placed at the 2nd position on points table with 3 wins and 1 loss to their credit. They have 6 points to their name. 
 The top run scorer for Yas Lions in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Dasun Shanaka with 125 runs to his name. 
 The top wicket taker for Yas Lions in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Jason Holder with 5 scalps under his belt. 
 Yas Lions have won their previous match against Arabian Aces by a big margin of 29 runs.
 Yas Lions batted first and they posted a massive total of 132 for 5 in 10 overs. Andries Gous and James Vince got out cheaply. After their dismissals, Dasun Shanaka and Tom Moores played to their potential. They carted the bowlers to all parts of the ground, making 38 and 35 runs respectively. On the back of their brilliance with the bat, Yas Lions managed to get to a big total of 132 in 10 overs of play.
 During the chase, Arabian Aces lost their way right from the outset. They failed to fully utilize the Powerplay overs. Arabian Aces were reduced to 34 for 4 in the 5th over itself. Andre Russell made 29 quick runs but he also got out at a wrong time. After his dismissal, the lower order simply surrendered and Arabian Aces were eventually restricted to 103 for 7 in 10 overs, losing the match by a big margin of 29 runs.
